title: A whole-invoice fee with no labor or parts dollars goes to one side
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • {Location-A}'s Shop Supplies Charge is 0%, and nothing else is invoiced at {Location-A} today.
  • Three work orders for {Customer-A} each have only a whole-invoice fee of $25.00 and no labor or parts dollars: {Work-order-1} with Labor {Sales-rep-A} and Parts {Sales-rep-B}; {Work-order-2} with Labor "Unassigned" and Parts {Sales-rep-B}; {Work-order-3} with both sides "Unassigned" and a customer with no representative.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001, {Work-order-2} is S2-40002 and {Work-order-3} is S2-40003.
  • Starting screen: the Work Orders page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Invoice {Work-order-1}.
  2. Invoice {Work-order-2}.
  3. Invoice {Work-order-3}.
  4. Open Reports > Sales By Representative.
  5. Set the date range to today.
  6. Turn Show Unassigned on.
  7. Find each invoice's fee in the report.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Work-order-1}'s invoice is created.
  • Step 2: {Work-order-2}'s invoice is created.
  • Step 3: {Work-order-3}'s invoice is created.
  • Step 4: the Sales By Representative report opens.
  • Step 5: the report shows today's date range.
  • Step 6: Show Unassigned is on and the report shows today's invoices.
  • Step 7: {Work-order-1}'s $25.00 is credited to {Sales-rep-A} (the labor representative); {Work-order-2}'s $25.00 to {Sales-rep-B} (the parts representative, because the labor side has no representative); {Work-order-3}'s $25.00 to Unassigned.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R8: “A whole-invoice amount on an invoice with no labor and no parts dollars goes to the labor representative. If the labor side is empty and the parts side is not, it goes to the parts representative. If both are empty, it is Unassigned. A side is empty when it has no representative.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 23: “23. (a) The labor side has no sales representative.”
